svg.title: Ranking well is not the same as knowing the risk.

cc:Work.dc:title: Ranking well is not the same as knowing the risk.
cc:Work.dc:description: Held-out test: n=114 · selected by validation log loss: Logistic regression · no test-set tuning Source: pinned UCI WDBC snapshot. Top intervals: 500 stratified bootstrap resamples of fixed-model test predictions. Calibration bars: 95% Wilson intervals in 5 fixed-width bins. Neither interval captures retraining or hospital-shift uncertainty.
